alder noun

also alder tree

classical

Verg. G. 2.110 (Lewis & Short)
Plin. NH 16.218 (Lewis & Short)
Catull. 17.18 (Lewis & Short)

alnus, alnī f.

noun, second declension

alder tree

The tree of wet ground and river banks. In the poets also a boat, since boats were made of it (Verg. G. 1.136, Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • flūminibus salicēs crassīsque palūdibus alnī nāscuntur, sterilēs saxōsīs montibus ornī

    willows grow by rivers and alders in thick marshes, barren ashes on rocky hillsVerg. G. 2.110–111

See also tree, willow, poplar, birch, swamp.

SourcesLewis & Short: alnus

Vergil, Georgica 2.110–111.
